info.title: PathFinder ICT — Static Data & Deep-Link API
info.summary: Career-path data and shareable URLs for the PathFinder ICT student site.
info.description:
PathFinder ICT is a **static website** with no backend. This document describes everything a static host serves for it:

1. **Data** — read-only JSON files: the 39 ICT job roles, the 6 sectors, the 38 COSMO courses linked to those roles, and a role → courses index. These are the only machine-readable resources.
2. **Pages** — the single-page app and its deep-link query parameters. Every roadmap is a URL, e.g. `/?goal=ciso&from=hnd`.
3. **Share redirects** — `/r/{sectorId}/` pages that give link previews a sector image, then redirect to the app with the same query string.
4. **Assets** — Open Graph images, fonts, CSS and JavaScript modules.

**Read-only.** Only `GET` (and implicitly `HEAD`) is supported. There is no authentication, no cookies, no tracking and no rate limiting beyond what the host applies.

**Computed results are client-side.** The roadmap (path, study step, status badges, header numbers) is computed in the browser by `js/path.js` from `roles.json`. No endpoint returns a roadmap. The `Roadmap` and `StepStatus` schemas below document that computed shape for integrators who reimplement the logic.

**Courses and career paths.** Every COSMO course carries `careerLinks` to BIICF roles, and `/data/role-courses.json` gives the reverse view. Each link has a `fit`:

| fit | Meaning | How it is decided |
|---|---|---|
| `qualifies` | The course meets an entry route for the role with no experience needed. | Rule: route BDQF ≤ course BDQF, and the route's subject (e.g. "in IT, IS or Computer Science") matches the course subject. |
| `needs-experience-or-portfolio` | Qualification met; BIICF also expects some unspecified experience or a portfolio. | Same rule; the route's `years` is null. |
| `with-experience` | Qualification met; `years` of experience are also needed. | Same rule; the route needs `years` > 0. Experience is cumulative across a career. |
| `builds-skills` | A short course that builds skills, certifications or job titles listed for the role. It is not an entry qualification. | Curated by hand; `why` explains the link. |

Qualification links use the same entry routes and BDQF rules as the website's roadmap, so the two always agree. BDQF levels for BTEC Levels 1–3 and City & Guilds are **estimated** from the UK RQF level (`bdqfSource: "estimated"`); confirm with COSMO before relying on them.

**Source and disclaimer.** Data is based on the Brunei ICT Industry Competency Framework (https://www.biicf.bn). PathFinder ICT is an unofficial student guide and is not affiliated with AITI, MISC or BIICF. Always check the official site for the latest requirements. Course data is from cosmo.edu.bn (October 2026); fees, intakes and entry requirements are on each course page.

get.summary: List all 38 COSMO courses with their career links
get.description:
Every COSMO course: BTEC and City & Guilds qualifications (with level, BDQF level and the next course up), COSMO Certified Programs (CCP) short courses, The AI Board awards and English. `careerLinks` lists the BIICF roles each course leads to or prepares for. Courses outside ICT (logistics, health and safety, hospitality) are included with no links and a `note`.

To find courses for one role, filter `careerLinks[].role`, or use `/data/role-courses.json`.

get.summary: COSMO courses for each career role (reverse index)
get.description:
An object with one key per role id (all 39 roles). Each value lists the courses linked to that role, best fit first: `qualifies`, then `needs-experience-or-portfolio`, then `builds-skills`, then `with-experience` (fewest years first). A role with no linked course has an empty array.

Typical use: show "Study this at COSMO" on a role or roadmap step. Read `roleCourses[goal]`.

get.summary: Open the app (any screen, via query parameters)
get.description:
The single-page app. The screen shown depends on the query parameters, checked in this order:

| Parameters | Screen |
|---|---|
| `view=quiz` | 30-second quiz (or a quiz result with `result`) |
| `view=explore` or `compare` | Explore all careers, optional side-by-side comparison |
| `goal` + `from` | **Roadmap** for that goal from that starting point |
| `goal` only | "Where are you right now?" |
| none | Landing page |

Unknown or invalid values never cause an HTTP error: the page always returns 200 and the app falls back to a sensible screen (an unknown `goal` shows the landing page with a notice). `mode=present` can be added to any screen.

The server ignores all query parameters; they are read by the browser. A shared link reopens the identical roadmap.

200.description: The app shell. Content is rendered client-side from the query parameters.

get.description: Same document as `/`, accepting the same query parameters.

get.summary: Shared roadmap link with a per-sector preview
get.description:
A small HTML page carrying Open Graph and Twitter tags for the sector (title and `og-{sectorId}.png` image), so WhatsApp, Instagram DMs and other chat apps show a rich preview.

In a browser it immediately redirects with JavaScript to `../../` (the app) keeping the **same query string and hash**. Crawlers do not run JavaScript, so they read the preview tags instead.

The app builds these links itself when the user taps "Share my path", e.g. `/r/ict-security/?goal=ciso&from=hnd`.

200.description: Redirect page with preview meta tags. Not indexed (`robots: noindex`).

goal.name: goal
goal.description: Target role. With `from` it opens the roadmap; alone it opens "Where are you right now?".

from.name: from
from.description: Starting point. `olevel` = BDQF 3, `alevel` = BDQF 4 (A Level, HNTec), `hnd` = BDQF 5, `degree` = BDQF 6, `working` = treated as BDQF 5 with work experience.

exp.name: exp
exp.description: Years of work experience. The app slider covers 0–15 (15 shown as "15+"); values up to 50 are accepted. Invalid values become 0.

w.name: w
w.description: Set to `1` when the user chose "Already working" and then picked a qualification. Changes the "You are here" label.

r.name: r
r.description: Set to `1` to show the alternative route (Route B) where the road splits. Ignored if the goal has no alternative.

view.name: view
view.description: Open the quiz or the explore page.

compare.name: compare
compare.description: One or two comma-separated role ids to compare side by side on the explore page. Unknown ids are dropped; only the first two are used.

stage.name: stage
stage.description: Explore page filter by career stage.

result.name: result
result.description: With `view=quiz`, shows the quiz result for this sector without retaking the quiz.

mode.name: mode
mode.description: Teacher mode for classroom projectors: hides navigation and enlarges the roadmap. Stays on while navigating; never included in share links.

CacheControlShort.description: Recommended caching (see `_headers` for Netlify). Hosts may differ.

NotFound.description: The file does not exist. The body is the host's own 404 page and its format varies by host.

Stage.description: Career stage used for colour and filtering. A PathFinder grouping, not a BIICF field. Labels: Entry, Mid-career, Senior, Top.

Bdqf.description: Brunei Darussalam Qualifications Framework level. 3 = O Level, 4 = A Level / HNTec, 5 = HND / Diploma, 6 = Bachelor's, 7 = Master's, 8 = Doctorate. `0` means any qualification (used with a certification route).

short.description: Short label for chips and buttons.

color.description: Accent colour for dots, chips and borders. Not for text (contrast).

Route.description: One way into a role: a minimum qualification plus minimum experience.

years.description: Minimum years of experience. `null` means "some experience, not specified" (often "or a relevant portfolio"). BIICF experience is cumulative, not per step.

Skill.description: A `[name, level]` pair. Level is 1–5 (1 Follow, 2 Assist, 3 Apply, 4 Ensure, 5 Strategise). `"3→4"` means the level rises within the role; `"2–3"` is a range.

aka.description: Nicknames and alternate titles, used by search.

summary.description: One line on what the person does.

next.description: Roles this role progresses to (same sector). Empty for top roles.

routes.description: Entry routes. Empty when `unavailable` is true.

skills.description: Key technical skills (up to 5). Empty when `unavailable` is true.

soft.description: Soft-skill level summary (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert). Empty when `unavailable` is true.

unavailable.description: True when the official page has no details yet (Data Architect). Show "Details coming soon".

CourseType.description: `qualification` = BTEC, City & Guilds, HNTec or NTec with a level. `short-course` = COSMO Certified Program (CCP) or The AI Board award, a few weeks long. `language` = English language certification.

CourseFit.description: How a course relates to a role. See the table in the API description.

CareerLink.description: One link from a course to a BIICF role.

years.description: Years of experience also needed on the matching route. 0 for `qualifies`; null for `needs-experience-or-portfolio` and `builds-skills`.

route.description: The BIICF entry route the course satisfies (its `note`). Null for `builds-skills`.

why.description: For `builds-skills`: which skill, certification or job title in the role the course matches.

provider.description: Cosmopolitan College of Commerce & Technology, Brunei.

awardingBody.description: Who awards the certificate, e.g. Pearson BTEC, City and Guilds, COSMO, The AI Board.

level.description: Level as named by the awarding body (BTEC/City & Guilds). Null for short courses and HNTec/NTec.

bdqf.description: BDQF level the qualification gives, used to match role entry routes. Null for short courses.

bdqfSource.description: `biicf-table` = the qualification is named in BIICF's BDQF table (HND, HNTec, NTec). `estimated` = mapped from the UK RQF level; confirm with COSMO.

nextCourse.description: The next COSMO qualification up the same ladder (e.g. Level 3 → HND).

url.description: Course page on cosmo.edu.bn (fees, intakes, entry requirements).

careerLinks.description: Roles this course leads to or prepares for. Empty for courses outside ICT.

note.description: Present when `careerLinks` is empty or needs explaining.

RoleCourse.description: One course entry in the role → courses index.

RoleCoursesIndex.description: Keys are role ids. The served file always contains all 39 roles (empty array when no course is linked); examples show only a few.

StepStatus.description: **Computed client-side** (`stepStatus` in `js/path.js`), not served by any endpoint. The status badge for one role on the roadmap.

soft.description: True when the route needs unspecified experience and the user has none: "You qualify (with a portfolio)".

type.description: 🎓 Qualification not met on any route.

Roadmap.description:
**Computed client-side** (`buildRoadmap` in `js/path.js`), not served by any endpoint. Documented for anyone reimplementing the logic.

- **Path:** BFS over `next` from the sector's entry roles to the goal; shortest chain first, ties go to the first listed `next`. An alternative of the same length or one step longer becomes Route B.
- **Status rule:** a route is eligible if user BDQF ≥ route BDQF. The best eligible route needs the least experience (`null` counts as 0), then prefers an explicit number, then the higher BDQF.
- **Header years:** experience the goal needs on the user's best route, or on the BDQF 5 route if the user qualifies for none. Never summed across steps.
- **Study step:** added when user BDQF is below the first role's lowest route.

ids.description: Role ids on the shown route, entry first, goal last.

study.description: Study step shown before the first role, or null.

split.description: Index of the last shared role before the routes diverge; -1 when there is no alternative.

years.description: Experience needed at the goal; null if unspecified or unavailable.

firstOk.description: Index of the first ✅ step, or -1.

furthestOk.description: Index of the furthest ✅ step ("Fast track"), or -1.
